{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify: now each patient appears once
print(f"Number of unique patients after dedup: {df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check site distribution
print(df_dedup['site'].value_counts())

# Compute response rate by site
response_rates = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print(response_rates)

# Confirm the number of sites
print(f"Number of unique sites: {df_dedup['site'].nunique()}")"}
